name: Four Seasons Resort Bali at Jimbaran Bay
positioning: Beach resort of thatched-roof Balinese pool villas on Jimbaran Bay, on Bali’s southwest coast
best_for: Travelers who want a private pool villa on a Bali beach
Families wanting a kids club and multi-bedroom villas

facts.text: The resort has 156 rooms in total.
The resort has a Balinese village design with thatched-roof villas nestled among landscaped tropical gardens.
Each villa has a private plunge pool.
The resort is on Bali’s southwest coast, in a corner of Jimbaran Village’s 3-mile (4.8-kilometre) crescent of golden sand.
The resort is 20 minutes from Ngurah Rai International Airport.
Sundara Beach Club serves seafood barbecues.
The Healing Village Spa has 10 all-suite treatment rooms.
The resort has three outdoor pools.

highlights.text: A floating breakfast is served at your private villa pool.
The Imperial Three-Bedroom Pool Villa is a two-storey beachfront villa with a private chef.
The Imperial Three-Bedroom Pool Villa has its own infinity pool.
Guests can learn to cook signature Balinese dishes at the Jimbaran Bay Cooking Academy.
The resort offers a heli-surfing day trip to Indonesia’s G-Land.
Umah Rare Kids Club operates daily from 9:00 am to 7:00 pm.

considerations.text: The resort is 45 minutes from nightlife in Seminyak.
The Private Ubud Heritage Tour is an 8-hour outing from the resort.
WhataHotel notes the distance from Bali’s cultural center in Ubud.
WhataHotel notes a premium luxury price point.

perks.text: With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, breakfast for two is free daily.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a priority upgrade if available at check-in.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a $100 hotel credit.
WhataHotel special offers can be combined with the exclusive perks.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get free Wi-Fi access.
